Product Features

  • Color and Size: This 80 x 40 x 138 cm display case is made of MDF material and has a shelf load capacity of 5 kg. It is characterized by a collision of black and wood grain colors and a three-dimensional 5-layer structure. Placed in the living room or study, it is not only a good storage tool, but also a work of art that combines retro and modern styles, brightening up the style of the room.
  • Rebound Switch Cabinet Door: 2 cabinet doors use a rebound switch, which is super convenient to open by pressing lightly. The transparent acrylic plate allows the collections and figures to be clearly presented. Each display layer can become the visual focal point, making storage an "immersive viewing experience".
  • Large storage space: 6 divided storage compartments + 2 drawers, finely divided storage space! Books, blind boxes and small ornaments are all put in their place. You don't have to rummage around in boxes and cupboards to find things. With one click, the clutter can "disappear" and the cleanliness in the living room increases rapidly.
  • LED Light Strip: Bluetooth light strip + mobile phone app control, it's simply the "magic key" to the atmosphere! When watching a movie, set the light to a warm color so that the exhibits can tell their own story. Switch to colored light for a party and the display case immediately becomes the "center of atmosphere", suitable for different life scenes.
  • Anti-Tilt: The anti-tilt design is extremely considerate, so families with children can also feel comfortable! Even if the children mischievously bump into it, the cupboard stands stable as a rock. It is fully equipped with safety details to give you a peace of mind at home.
  • Acrylic Cabinet Doors: Transparent acrylic cabinet doors + divided storage allow for a perfect combination of "storage + presentation". Beloved figures and valuable books can thus be professionally stored and "presented" at any time. When friends come, their eyes will be fixed here, so he will easily become the "king of social issues" in the living room.
  • Multifunctional: It is very convenient to control the lights via the mobile phone app. You can switch the lighting modes while lying on the sofa. During the day, the details of the collections can be easily displayed and at night, light and shadow can create an atmosphere. The display case can be placed "nicely online" at different times in order to adapt to the diverse rhythm of life.
  • 5-Layer Design: From the scientific 5-layer layout to the practical rebound doors, to the smart light strips and anti-dumping safety device, this display case combines storage, presentation and atmosphere. The MDF material ensures durability and the black and brown color scheme matches various decorations. It is definitely the "all-round king of storage and presentation" for modern homes and gives each item its own "stage".
  • USB Powered – Comes with a 5V 2A USB cable (USB plug not included) that can be connected to your TV, computer, power bank, etc. Safe and easy to use indoors
  • NOTE: This product consists of two packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages have arrived before you start assembling!
